item.title: Reuse existing money helpers for Decimal arithmetic
item.description: When implementing monetary calculations, use the project's existing money utilities (to_money, round_money, ZERO) rather than raw Decimal operations.
item.content: Inspect ledgerly/money.py and sibling functions like line_total/invoice_total to match rounding and normalization conventions. Wrap unit prices with to_money, seed sums with ZERO, and round the final result with round_money.

item.title: Guard division by zero with the domain's zero constant
item.description: For weighted-average or ratio computations, check the denominator (total quantity) before dividing and return the project's ZERO constant.
item.content: Compute total_quantity first; if it equals 0 (empty invoice or zero-quantity lines), return ZERO instead of raising ZeroDivisionError. This satisfies the 'no lines means zero' requirement cleanly.

item.title: Read the existing test file before implementing
item.description: Locating and reading the relevant test file (tests/test_average_unit_price.py) alongside models.py and money.py clarified expected types and behavior before writing code.
item.content: Before editing, cat the target module, its models, its money helpers, and any test file matching the feature name. This reveals signatures, Decimal usage, and edge cases, enabling a first-attempt pass.
